svg.text: which numbers go into the mean and the variance?
drops the mean and the shift
A Transformer cannot use BatchNorm: sequences in a batch have different lengths, inference often runs at batch
size 1, and the running statistics make train and eval behave differently. LayerNorm removes the batch axis
from the statistics altogether. RMSNorm then notices that re-centring buys almost nothing once the network has
learned to live without it, so Gemma keeps only the rescaling.
